tess: heads-up — ran the quickstart and hit a silent typing regression after the edge bundle. generics from our helpers collapse to `unknown`/`any`.

nate: can you paste the tiny repro? is it the overloads/generic mapping again?

tess: minimal: `export function call<T>(opts: ReqOptions): Promise<T>; export function call(opts: ReqOptions){ return runtime.request(opts) }` then `const x = await call<{id:string}>({route: '/me'})` — works in node, edge bundle gives `x: any`.

jun: bundler? vite/rollup? package.json exports? those often flip which .d.ts path the bundler resolves.

tess: vite -> rollup. package.json has dual exports and `types` points to `dist/types/index.d.ts`. edge bundle pipeline flattens/rewrites imports and that seems to break overload visibility.

harper: FYI TS widens to `any` when it can't reconcile overloads. If the final emitted declaration loses a single canonical signature inference fails.

nate: short-term: change helper to a single generic signature `function call<T>(opts: ReqOptions & {response:'json'}): Promise<T>` or add discriminant in opts. less magic for users.

jun: or make package exports explicit for edge: add "types/edge": "dist/types/esm/index.d.ts" style entry so bundler picks correct d.ts.

tess: I tried `skipLibCheck: true` and pinning `moduleResolution: node` in sample tsconfig — that prevented the rewrite and CI typecheck passed. PR ready.

harper: also looked at auth/retry wrappers — when typed as overloads they lose contextual types in certain edge builds. we should audit wrappers and prefer single-generic + discriminants.

pkg-bot: CI report: node-cjs typecheck: OK. edge-bundle typecheck: failed on master at 2667890000; branch `devex/edge-typing-quickfix` shows green.

nate: action items: 1) update quickstart README with a short "edge bundler TS caveats" snippet; 2) add an edge-bundle + tsc job to sample CI; 3) adjust helper typings in SDK to avoid overload ambiguity.

tess: opened PR and issue with repro. dropping links in the issue. thanks all. :raised_hands:
